# Bell

Type: Misc | Internal ID: Bell | Source: Black forge | Usage: Summon, Fader | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Crafting Materials: Bell fragment x3

# Introduction

A Bell is an item used to summon the Ashlands boss Fader.
Bells are crafted at the Black forge using 3 Bell fragments obtained from Charred Fortresses.
Three bells are used to summon Fader, requiring a total of 9 bell fragments.

Categorias: Misc Items, Forsaken offerings
